name: 预售（发布/接龙/统计）工具

map.预售（发布/接龙/统计）工具是做什么的？: What does Pre-Order / Group Buy Statistics Tool do?
map.如何使用预售（发布/接龙/统计）工具？: How do I use Pre-Order / Group Buy Statistics Tool?
map.预售（发布/接龙/统计）工具适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Pre-Order / Group Buy Statistics Tool best for?
map.把接龙或报名的名单连同份数贴入文本框，每行一条，姓名与份数用逗号、空格或制表符分: Paste the group-buy or sign-up list with quantities into the text box, one entry per line, with name and quantity separated by a comma, space or tab; a name alone counts as 1 portion. The tool summarises the number of people, total portions, average portions per person and the largest and smallest single orders, then converts to a pre-order amount by unit price, for on-the-spot settlement of group buys, pre-orders and campaign sign-ups. Data is processed locally in the browser and is not uploaded.
map.📖 查看「预售（发布/接龙/统计）工具使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pre-Order / Group Buy Statistics Tool Guide"
map.预售统计 = 明细行汇总：总人数 = 有效行数；总数量 = Σ 各行数量（未填数: Pre-order statistics = summary of detail rows: total people = number of valid rows; total quantity = Σ each row quantity (a missing quantity defaults to 1); tiered amount = unit price × quantity; share = single quantity ÷ total quantity × 100%; buyers with the same name are merged as one person, for reconciling group-buy or sign-up summaries.
map.接龙名单（每行一条：姓名 份数）: Group-buy list (one per line: name and quantity)
map.📚 深度解析：预售接龙人数与金额统计: 📚 In-Depth: Pre-Order Group-Buy Headcount and Amount Statistics
map.团购、预售或社区接龙时把群内名单连同份数贴入，一次算出人数、总份数与金额。: For group buying, pre-orders or a community group-buy, paste the group list with quantities to get the headcount, total quantity and amount in one go.
map.按收款记录或订单导出核对：把已付款名单贴入，用「合计份数 × 单价」与实际到账金: Reconcile against payment records or an order export: paste the list of those who have paid and compare "total quantity × unit price" with the amount actually received to quickly spot underpayments and overpayments.
map.活动报名截止后快速出核销表：找出下单最多与最少的参与者，安排配送或分批发货。: Produce a redemption sheet quickly after sign-ups close: identify the participants who ordered the most and the least to arrange delivery or dispatch in batches.
map.名单五行分别为张丽 2、王强 1、李娜 3、赵敏 2、陈锋 4，单价 68 元。: The five rows are Alice 2, Bob 1, Carol 3, Dave 2 and Eve 4, with a unit price of 68 CNY. The tool counts 5 people, a total of 12 portions and 2.40 portions per person, giving a pre-order amount of 12 × 68 = 816.00 CNY and 163.20 CNY per person, which you can use to reconcile the collection.
map.只写姓名的情况: When only a name is given
map.若某行只有姓名没有数字，工具默认按 1 份计，不会漏掉该条；若整行只有数字没有姓: If a row has only a name and no number, the tool counts it as 1 portion and does not drop it; if a row has only a number and no name, it is also counted as a valid entry, which suits pasting a single column of quantities from a spreadsheet.
map.姓名与份数之间用逗号、顿号、分号、制表符或空格分隔都可以，中文全角逗号同样支持；: A name and quantity may be separated by a comma, an enumeration comma, a semicolon, a tab or a space, and full-width commas are supported too; a quantity of 0 or a negative number is treated as 1 portion to avoid a total being zeroed out.
map.名单要按什么格式写？: What format should the list use?
map.每行一条，姓名在前、份数在后，中间用逗号或空格分隔；只写姓名则按 1 份计。不要: One entry per line, name first then quantity, separated by a comma or space; a name alone counts as 1 portion. Do not put several people's names on one line, or they will be treated as the name part of the same participant.
map.能去重或识别重复报名吗？: Can it de-duplicate or detect repeated sign-ups?
map.不能。工具严格按照行统计，同一姓名出现两次会算作两个条目。需要去重请先在表格里处: No. The tool counts strictly by row, so a name appearing twice is counted as two entries. To de-duplicate, process the data in a spreadsheet first, or check the headcount by hand after counting.
map.金额为 0 或不显示怎么办？: What if the amount is 0 or not shown?
map.先确认单价填写正确；若仍然异常，多数是名单被过滤器全部滤掉了（例如整段为空）。名: First check that the unit price is correct; if it is still wrong, the list has probably been filtered out entirely (for example it is blank). When the list is empty the tool prompts you to paste one rather than returning a headcount of 0.
map.聚合报名、付款与时段分布，输出转化漏斗与参与结构，辅助活动节奏与备货。: Aggregate sign-ups, payments and time-slot distribution to output a conversion funnel and participation structure, aiding campaign pacing and stock preparation.
